title: 8x8 Procedural Images: Two Photometric Intensity Levels
intuition: Tests photometric amplitude fidelity rather than spatial position: a centered 4x4 square must be generated at both target brightnesses (0.35 and 0.85) with tight template RMSE (<= 0.06).
failure_mode: Trainers collapse to a single intermediate gray level (~0.60) or drop the dimmer/brighter mode entirely.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 held image task (600 updates, tighter quality_rmse <= 0.06).
